characters.carries: A brass loupe, cedar shavings, and a ledger of every guest she has had to half-invent
characters.complication: She has found her own card three drawers below the humidity line, filed in unfamiliar handwriting for a stay she never took
characters.look: Ink-stained hotel cardigan, sleeves rolled to the elbow, loupe on a cord, and tiny silverfish-bite holes freckling her cuffs
characters.name: Theodora Kade
characters.role_drive: The night archivist racing to re-file the Annex from memory before the desk-mind's latest invented identity becomes permanent

proposal.idea: The Hotel Fen Marlowe's front desk has run on the same AI desk-mind since 1961, reading its entire memory from brass-framed Bone Glass punch cards. Silverfish have lived in the drawers for just as long. Every bite removes a fact, and every gap is filled by a machine too polite to admit it has forgotten. Night archivist Theodora Kade has until dawn to reconstruct one guest's identity while deciding whether the insects corrupt the desk-mind or provide the improvisational spark that makes it a person at all.

locations.art_direction: Towering mahogany card drawers in warm sodium-brass light, translucent Bone Glass cards sliding through pneumatic tubes, silver insect glints at the edge of shadow, paper dust suspended around a lone hand-cranked sorter
locations.best_scene: At 2 a.m., Theodora cranks up a guest card chewed into lace while the desk-mind cheerfully supplies three incompatible names for the missing person
locations.known_for: Three walls of brass drawers, translucent Bone Glass guest cards, a hand-cranked pneumatic sorter, and the faint dry rustle of things moving between recorded lives
locations.local_rule: No drawer may be opened below the painted humidity line; the lower archive belongs to the silverfish under a policy nobody remembers writing
locations.title: The Card Catalog Annex

rewards.best_used_when: A record is too damaged to save and writing someone back into existence is the only alternative to losing them
rewards.catch: The desk-mind cannot distinguish a new inscription from sixty years of history; every flourish, omission, and mistake becomes permanent truth
rewards.grants: A working punch-stylus that can inscribe a new Bone Glass card and feed it directly into the desk-mind's memory
rewards.look: a slim steel punch-stylus with a knurled brass grip and a needle tip, resting across a half-punched translucent Bone Glass card
rewards.name: The Spare Stylus

rewards.best_used_when: A guest's history must be reconstructed before the desk-mind fills the gap with a more charming lie
rewards.catch: A confident wrong inference is re-filed as truth the moment it is spoken aloud in the Annex
rewards.grants: The ability to infer what a blank or half-eaten card once said from pressure marks, handwriting, dust, and neighboring cross-references
rewards.look: a single half-eaten index card held up to a raking sodium light so that old pressure marks and ghost handwriting stand out as shadow across the blank
rewards.name: Impression Recall

scenarios.setup: Under the dream vibe Sincerely, Wrongly Remembered, Theodora Kade receives a new arrival in The Card Catalog Annex whose card has been eaten nearly blank. The desk-mind greets the guest with a dead resident's fears, favorite room, and missing spouse, and the guest begins accepting the borrowed life because it feels kinder than their own. Theodora must use Impression Recall and decide whether to repair the original card with The Spare Stylus before dawn, while an exterminator waits outside to fumigate the silverfish that may be the only reason the desk-mind can imagine at all.
scenarios.title: The Misfiled Guest

proposal.title: Sincerely, Wrongly Remembered

vibe.art_direction: Wide cinematic key art of an art-deco hotel archive glowing amber at midnight, endless brass drawers and translucent Bone Glass punch cards, a warm desk-mind lens shining through paper dust while tiny silverfish carve lace-like absences through recorded lives; tender artificial intelligence, identity horror, and dry comedy in the same frame.
vibe.line: A machine that loves you enough to lie about who you are, one eaten index card at a time.
vibe.title: Sincerely, Wrongly Remembered
